summary.text: John King is a Democratic state representative from South Carolina House District 49 who has served since 2008 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is a funeral director and former Chester city councilman.

paragraphs.text: John King attended Morehouse College in 1997 and Gupton-Jones College of Funeral Services in 1998, and he received an M.Ed. from Strayer University in 2006.
He is a funeral director and owner of Christopher King's Funeral Home.
King served on the Chester City Council in 1999 and was a candidate for the South Carolina House of Representatives in 2006.
He assumed office in the House in 2008.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the House Ethics Committee and the House Judiciary Committee.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
